title: johnstonella costata
intro: Johnstonella costata, commonly known as desert trumpet, is a flowering plant species in the borage family, Boraginaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, making it useful for alleviating symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of Johnstonella costata include alkaloids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
